maturityLevels.available: Published package and implemented network behavior.
maturityLevels.source_available: Implemented on the SDK main branch but not confirmed in the public registry artifact.
maturityLevels.contract_preview: Typed API that deliberately fails closed because its required runtime bridge is not available.
maturityLevels.planned: No supported public client behavior yet.

python.note: The PyPI project name 'cognitum' is owned by an unrelated third party; this SDK's distribution name is 'cognitum-sdk' while the import name stays 'cognitum' (from cognitum import Cognitum).

agenticCore.description: Shared contract layer every product client builds on: credential providers (static API key + OAuth token) with origin/audience/product binding and scope preflight, typed error taxonomy with equal-jitter retry and idempotency binding, execution receipt and lineage verification (shape/digest/cryptographic/anchored ladder, HMAC-SHA256), a bounded-depth secret redaction sentinel, and W3C trace-context parse/generate/join primitives.
notes: Telemetry primitives (TelemetrySink interface, no-op default sink, event/metric-name catalog, diagnostic capture policy) are public, tested contracts as of v0.3.0, but zero product client currently wires them into a real emission call site -- there is no active telemetry pipeline yet.
OpenTelemetry adapter integration is not implemented.

metaLlm.description: Real HTTP-backed client for all five Meta-LLM serving protocols.

streaming.messages.create: native Anthropic event types, same parser

features: idempotency-key generation and bounded 429/502/503 retry on non-streaming calls
ADR-0024b routing controls and read-only usage/receipt access
notes: Meta-LLM platform resources (batches, pods, benchmarks, Brain, vectors, collaboration, flywheel) do not yet have typed SDK resource clients -- accessed via the REST API until issue #59 completes the product-resource layer.

metaProxy.description: Local data-plane client: status/capabilities discovery, routing-intent-aware non-streaming and streaming chat.completions forwarding, with consent gating on the cognitum_cloud routing plane and a browser-runtime rejection guard.
notes: Sponsor/budget operations remain fail-closed stubs pending ADR-0025b (MetaProxyManager lifecycle -- discovery, signed install, sponsor ledger), which has not been started.

harnessaas.description: Scoped strictly to the real, deployed synchronous surface: health, solve, and lineage. Vertical-support capability gate on solve() (only code-repair fully modeled today).
notes: ADR-0027a's proposed async job/poll/SSE/approval/artifact contract is NOT implemented -- it does not exist upstream yet; building against it would produce bindings matching zero live routes.
ADR-0027b (isolation, evidence, webhook contract) is not started.

metaharness.description: Construction (zero I/O) and the full ADR-0026a §D2 method surface, every operation a typed, fail-closed stub. This is a contract preview, not operational behavior.
notes: The upstream OSS metaharness package has no published bridge --stdio protocol (or any versioned machine contract) this client could talk to yet -- ADR-0026a §D7 lists 7 explicit blockers.
No operation performs real process spawn, network I/O, or filesystem access -- confirmed via import-absence (zero child_process/fs/fetch references in the module).
Do not represent any MetaHarnessClient method as functioning until the upstream bridge protocol exists and this contract preview is promoted to available.

restFirstGaps.description: Batches, pods, benchmarks, Brain, vectors, collaboration, and flywheel namespaces are REST-only today -- no typed SDK resource client exists for any of them.
